g_roast: Ten years on a bus in Santiago, cabros. The drunk ones at midnight walked straighter than this party.
Five people, one road, and everybody still gets off at the wrong stop. That is a talent, weon.
g_fire_back: Ya, very funny, from the one who fell asleep on watch two nights running.
Careful, I see everything from the front. I saw what you did with the map.
g_pile_on: And then they argued with a door. The door won, cachai.
It is worse, I counted. Three times the same wrong turn, same face every time.
lines.g_peacemake: Ya, stop, both of you, please. Sit, eat something, and talk when your voices are smaller.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, but I am with this one. From the front, I saw it all, and they are right.
lines.g_left_out: You two are talking close, that is fine. I will watch the road for a while.
lines.g_include: Come, sit here, there is space. On my bus nobody stood when there was a seat.
lines.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple, cabros. We all run in, nobody watches the back, and we hope for the best.
lines.g_plan_yes: Ya, this is good, I like it. I take the front, so I see everybody.
lines.g_plan_no: No, weon, this plan is bad. Somebody falls in the gap, and nobody sees it happen.
lines.g_hype: Ya, cabros, stay close and keep your eyes open. I go first.
lines.g_toast: I do not talk much, so I will be short. To all of you, my regulars, who always get on.
lines.g_cheers: Salud, everybody, to your health. And somebody save me some bread.
g_quiet_line: That trader at the post was lying about the weight, by the way. I watched his hands.
Good morning for walking today, cold and clear. Like Santiago in winter, a little.
lines.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everybody, nobody rushes. First we count heads, then we breathe, then we try again.
lines.g_crew: On the bus I had forty faces every morning, and I knew them all. Now I have you. It is better, I think.
lines.g_exasperated: I said wait, I said watch the left, I even pointed. Chucha, and everybody went right.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see who is about to fall before they fall. On the bus, that was the whole job.
lines.g_love_kind: You give up your seat without anybody asking. On my bus, you would be my favourite passenger.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a quiet man. That is not easy, cachai.
lines.g_love_brave: You go in front and you do not make noise about it. That is the kind of brave I trust.
lines.g_love_steady: Your hands stay still in the worst moments. People like you keep a whole bus calm.
lines.g_love_clever: You understand things fast, before I finish explaining. That helps a man with slow English.
lines.g_love_honest: You say what is real, simple, with no extra. I can understand you always, and I like that.
lines.g_love_quiet: You give me time to find the next word. Not many people wait, and you always do.
lines.g_love_fierce: You do not give up, ever, even when it hurts. Puta, I admire that.
lines.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like Sunday lunch at home, football on the television. I missed that feeling.
g_loved: Gracias, really, thank you. I do not have good words for this.
Ya, you will make me cry, weon, and I am at the front. Thank you, really.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You always find the soft place and push. On the bus I would put you off at the next stop.
lines.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am okay, please, I am okay. I am only quiet, quiet is not sad.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not everything must be a joke. Sometimes we just watch and stay quiet.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge with your eyes closed, every time. Somebody behind you always pays for it.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait and the moment leaves. Sometimes you just move, weon.
lines.g_hate_clever: You talk to me slowly, like I am stupid. My English is slow, my head is not.
lines.g_hate_honest: Everything in your head comes out loud, all of it. Some things you keep inside, cachai.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You keep your needs inside, then you are angry. Even I say something, sometimes.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight for you, even the bread. Nobody is fighting you for bread.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk and talk about nothing, all day. My ears need a rest, please.
lines.g_respect: I do not like you much, and you know it. But you held the front back there, and I saw it.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, weon. I said wait, and you did not wait, and look.
lines.g_stung: Ya, I heard. I will walk a little, alone.
lines.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, and it is true.
lines.g_nod: You also, good work. We do not need to say more.
lines.g_callback_save: I did not forget you pulled me out of that fight. I do not forget faces, or what they do.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two still standing, both shaking. I think about that one a lot, cachai.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was angry all day. Then I understood you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: At the start I did not trust you at all. Now I would stand in front of you every time.
lines.g_changed: My first year here I stopped talking completely. Now listen to me, talking all the time. It is strange.
g_unguarded: Just for you, then. On the bus I always got up for the grandmothers. Here I still look for a seat to give.
I am learning to read the writing here, slowly, from a woman at the trade post. Do not ask me why yet.
lines.g_clipped: Ya, fine, whatever you say. I will be in front.
lines.g_noticed_open: Look, a whole speech, and nobody stopped you. Ya, keep going, I like hearing it.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this one, please. I said my part, and they do not listen.
Ya, {player}, you choose for us. Then we both stop arguing.
lines.arg_backed_me: Gracias, {player}, thank you. I knew you saw it too.
lines.arg_backed_them: Ya, fine, your choice. I still think I was right.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Smart, very smart.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Always their side, {player}, every single argument. I notice, I notice everything.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide. I am right, and that is the end.
lines.arg_reject: Not that one, {player}, sorry. I saw how it ends, from the front.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I was right. Quietly, one time, and then I stop.
lines.arg_settled: Half right each, okay, ya. We shake hands and keep walking.
lines.seen_listens: You wait for me to finish my sentence, {player}, always. Most people finish it for me, wrong.
lines.seen_truth: You say things straight, {player}, simple words. With my English, that is a big help.
lines.seen_jokes: On the worst days you find something funny, {player}. On the night buses the drivers did that, and it helped everybody.
lines.seen_stays_out: Other people's fights, you leave alone, {player}. You watch the whole bus, like a conductor.
lines.seen_biased: One person always gets the best seat, {player}. Everybody on the bus can see.
lines.seen_harsh: Your words are rough sometimes, {player}. I am okay, but some of them are softer.
lines.seed_right: What you told me after that bad fight, {player}, I did not like it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
lines.seed_remember: I am still thinking about your words from that bad day. Slowly, like my English.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way did not work for me, {player}, it went worse. I only tell you, no problem.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I talk with you, {player}? That one was very close, and I do not say it to the others.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody went down, all of us at once. Sit with me, and we look at it step by step.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first one down, and I was at the front. From there I see everything, {player}, and I did not see that.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first stop to the last, everybody got off safe. On the bus, this was the best day.
lines.talk_development: Strange question, {player}. Do I seem different now? I talk more, and I do not know when it started.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been hard with {name}, I think. My English is short, so it comes out hard.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: One honest answer, {player}. Is {name} happy I ride with you, or am I just the quiet one at the front to them?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} makes me crazy, {player}, completely. But in a bad fight, I want them next to me.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, {player}. Their face changed, like a regular having a bad week.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, straight. The best gear keeps landing with {name}, and everybody on this bus sees it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it to your face, it is better. {name} and I do not get along, and I stop pretending.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into bad places with no exit, {player}, too often. I always take the front, but I want to come back.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, {player}, I was wrong. They saw it right and I did not, and I say it now before I get stubborn.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, {player}. On the big days, I stay behind. Is that the plan, or what you think of me?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My blade and armour went to {name}, and nobody told me anything. I would give them myself, {player}, if you just ask.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be okay, slowly. I always come back.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That is not what I needed to hear. I will walk alone a little.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you see it too, okay. Then it is real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no. We will see later.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read me wrong this time.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Ya, that is fair. I will talk to {name}, carefully.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, I do not know. People are hard to read, even for me.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}, okay?
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that is fair, I accept. I am a little angry still, but it passes.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, I heard, {player}. Give me some time with it.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that is the answer. Now I know.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, enough of this one, please. I will be at the front.
lines.arc_cracks: Yesterday I told a whole story at the fire, start to end, and nobody had to wait for me. I surprised myself, {player}.
lines.arc_turn: My first year here I stopped talking because nothing was worth translating. Now I want to say things, every day, and it scares me a little.
lines.arc_become: I talk now, {player}, really talk, in my bad English and my good Spanish. There are things worth saying, and I want to say them while I can.
lines.arc_failed: It is easier to be quiet, I think. I will stay at the front and watch, and the words can wait.
lines.alt_turn: I said nothing for three days and nobody noticed, {player}. The quiet is comfortable again, and that is the dangerous part.
lines.alt_become: I am quiet again, mostly. I still watch everybody, but I do not say much now. It is easier this way.
g_roast_after: Still the worst passengers I ever had, cabros, and I would drive this route forever.
Late, loud, lost, all of you, and I would not change one face.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everybody, together, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we get up, and this time I talk you through it.
lines.g_toast_after: To all of you, who waited for my words until they came back. I will not stop talking now, sorry.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my route now, you are my regulars, every stop. I know every face, and I like every face.
g_quiet_line_after: I told a joke at the fire today, in English, and they laughed. A good joke, also.
I said good morning to everybody today. Out loud, every one, like on the bus.
g_loved_after: Gracias, really, and this time I have the words. I like that very much.
Ya, thank you, and I believe you. That is new.

history.open: Ten years I was a bus conductor in Santiago, {player}. Same route, same forty faces every morning. I knew who got off where, and who was having a bad week.

options.reply: Ya, always, I cannot stop. Who will fall, who will steal, who is scared. It is useful here, also.
Very much, yes. People think it is boring, but every morning is a little different. It is like that here too.

options.text: Bet you never missed a stop.
options.reply: Never, not once in ten years. Here I get lost on the first road every time, cachai.

history.open: This is a ticket punch, {player}, brass, from the old buses. I click it twice before every fight. Somebody asked if it is for luck. It is not luck.

options.reply: It is how a shift starts. Click, click, and then you work. That is all I will say today.
Gracias, thank you. Most people push. You do not push, and I notice that.

history.open: My mother and my brother were in Santiago, {player}. Benjamin, five years younger, he talks too much. I have not found them, on any list.

options.reply: My mother cooks like nobody, and Sunday lunch was for the whole family, football on, Benja talking over the commentator. I miss the noise.
Ya, gracias, thank you. I look at every list. Every one, every hub. Thank you for saying we.

friend.open: The punch was my father's, {player}. We fought when I was twenty-four, and we did not speak for two years. Then he died, and I found out on the phone after a shift. I am learning to write here so I can write him a letter.

options.text: When it's done, I'll read it.
options.reply: Gracias, I mean it. I need someone to tell me it makes sense. There is nowhere to send it, but I want to write it anyway.

options.text: He knew you didn't hate him.
options.reply: I hope so, every day I hope. Thank you for saying it, {player}. I needed somebody to say it.

sworn.open: On the bus I watched everybody, {player}, but nobody watched me. You watch me. You wait for my words. You are family, weon, that is all I have to say.

options.reply: Ya, good, then it is decided. Now do not make me cry at the front.

options.text: Take all the time you need.
options.reply: That is exactly why, cachai. Thank you, always.

reconciled.open: {name} and I talked, properly, all of it. We are okay now, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Ya, it is good. Less silence now.
Me, believe it or not. I am learning.
